description: UNAVAILABLE: Felix cannot cancel a submitted withdrawal, and this tool refuses up front rather than pretending to. It spends no gas, signs nothing and moves no money. A broadcast Polygon transfer is final: wait for it to confirm and reconcile with get_money_map, get_balances and list_recent_operations, or reconcile the owner nonce with support if it is stuck. Never submit a replacement transfer at a fresh nonce.

idempotency_key.description: Required cancellation workflow key. Reuse the exact key after interruption.

transaction_hash.description: Optional known zero-value cancellation hash: verify it without signing or sending anything.

name: cancel_withdrawal
